WITH max_dt AS (
    SELECT MAX(date) AS max_date FROM price_snapshots
)
SELECT
    mlp.product_name,
    mlp.brand,
    mlp.price_eur,
    mlp.skroutz_link
FROM mv_latest_prices mlp
CROSS JOIN max_dt
WHERE mlp.category = 'phone'
  AND mlp.last_seen = max_dt.max_date
  AND mlp.price_eur IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY mlp.price_eur ASC NULLS LAST
LIMIT 1

SELECT product_name, brand, price_eur, last_price_date, skroutz_link
FROM mv_latest_prices
WHERE category = 'laptop'
  AND last_seen = (SELECT MAX(date) FROM price_snapshots)
  AND price_eur IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY price_eur DESC NULLS LAST
LIMIT 1

SELECT

FROM products
GROUP BY category
ORDER BY product_count DESC
LIMIT 50

FROM price_snapshots
WHERE date = (SELECT MAX(date) FROM price_snapshots)
LIMIT 50

    skroutz_link
FROM vw_biggest_drops

WITH max_dt AS (
    SELECT MAX(date) AS max_date FROM price_snapshots
)
SELECT
    v.product_name,
    v.brand,
    v.drop_pct,
    v.drop_date,
    v.prev_price,
    v.new_price,
    v.skroutz_link
FROM vw_biggest_drops v
CROSS JOIN max_dt m
WHERE v.category = 'laptop'
  AND v.drop_date >= m.max_date - INTERVAL '7 days'
ORDER BY v.drop_pct ASC NULLS LAST
LIMIT 1

WITH latest_scrape AS (
    SELECT MAX(date) AS max_date FROM price_snapshots
)
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT product_id) AS products_dropped
FROM vw_biggest_drops, latest_scrape
WHERE drop_date = latest_scrape.max_date
LIMIT 50

SELECT COUNT(*) AS new_products_count
FROM products
WHERE first_seen >= (SELECT MAX(date) FROM price_snapshots) - INTERVAL '7 days'
LIMIT 50

WITH latest_date AS (
    SELECT MAX(date) AS dt FROM price_snapshots
)
SELECT ROUND(AVG(ps.price_eur)::numeric, 2) AS avg_price_eur
FROM price_snapshots ps
JOIN products p ON ps.product_id = p.id
CROSS JOIN latest_date ld
WHERE p.category = 'phone'
  AND ps.date = ld.dt
  AND ps.price_eur IS NOT NULL
LIMIT 50

SELECT brand, product_count
FROM mv_brand_summary
WHERE category = 'phone'
ORDER BY product_count DESC
LIMIT 1

SELECT median_price AS median_price_eur
FROM mv_brand_summary
WHERE category = 'tablet'
  AND brand = 'Apple'
LIMIT 1

SELECT
    product_name,
    brand,
    model,
    price_eur,
    skroutz_link
FROM mv_latest_prices
WHERE category = 'phone'
  AND product_name ILIKE '%iPhone 15%'
  AND last_seen = (SELECT MAX(date) FROM price_snapshots)
ORDER BY price_eur ASC NULLS LAST
LIMIT 1

WITH cheapest_s24 AS (
    SELECT id, product_name, brand
    FROM mv_latest_prices
    WHERE category = 'phone'
      AND brand = 'Samsung'
      AND product_name ILIKE '%Galaxy S24%'
    ORDER BY price_eur ASC NULLS LAST
    LIMIT 1
)
SELECT
    c.product_name,
    c.brand,
    mpf.all_time_low AS lowest_price_eur
FROM cheapest_s24 c
JOIN mv_price_floor mpf ON mpf.product_id = c.id
LIMIT 50

WITH cheapest_s24 AS (
    SELECT id
    FROM mv_latest_prices
    WHERE brand = 'Samsung'
      AND product_name ILIKE '%Galaxy S24%'
      AND price_eur IS NOT NULL
    ORDER BY price_eur ASC NULLS LAST
    LIMIT 1
)
SELECT
    mph.date,
    mph.price_eur
FROM mv_price_history mph
JOIN cheapest_s24 c ON mph.product_id = c.id
WHERE mph.date >= (
    SELECT max(date) FROM price_snapshots
) - INTERVAL '7 days'
ORDER BY mph.date
LIMIT 50

WITH latest_date AS (
    SELECT MAX(date) AS dt FROM price_snapshots
)
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT p.id) AS smartwatches_under_50_eur
FROM products p
JOIN price_snapshots ps ON ps.product_id = p.id
JOIN latest_date ld ON ps.date = ld.dt
WHERE p.category = 'smartwatch'
  AND ps.price_eur IS NOT NULL
  AND ps.price_eur < 50
LIMIT 50

SELECT
    product_name,
    brand,
    rating,
    reviews,
    price_eur,
    skroutz_link
FROM mv_latest_prices
WHERE category = 'laptop'
  AND reviews > 50
ORDER BY rating DESC NULLS LAST, reviews DESC NULLS LAST
LIMIT 1

SELECT COUNT(*) AS falling_trend_products
FROM mv_price_trend_direction
WHERE trend = 'falling'
LIMIT 50

WITH max_dt AS (
    SELECT max(date) AS max_date FROM price_snapshots
),
bounds AS (
    SELECT max_date, (max_date - interval '1 month')::date AS start_date FROM max_dt
),
first_day AS (
    SELECT date AS first_date, avg_price AS first_avg_price
    FROM mv_daily_market_index, bounds
    WHERE category = 'tablet'
      AND date BETWEEN bounds.start_date AND bounds.max_date
    ORDER BY date ASC
    LIMIT 1
),
last_day AS (
    SELECT date AS last_date, avg_price AS last_avg_price
    FROM mv_daily_market_index, bounds
    WHERE category = 'tablet'
      AND date BETWEEN bounds.start_date AND bounds.max_date
    ORDER BY date DESC
    LIMIT 1
)
SELECT
    f.first_date,
    f.first_avg_price,
    l.last_date,
    l.last_avg_price,
    l.last_avg_price - f.first_avg_price AS change_eur,
    round(100.0 * (l.last_avg_price - f.first_avg_price) / nullif(f.first_avg_price, 0), 2) AS pct_change
FROM first_day f, last_day l
LIMIT 50

SELECT COUNT(*) AS phone_count
FROM products
WHERE category = 'phone'
  AND ram_gb = 16
  AND last_seen = (SELECT MAX(date) FROM price_snapshots)
LIMIT 50

SELECT 'NO_DATA' AS no_data WHERE false
LIMIT 50
